title: Palindrome Number
description:
Given an integer `X`, return `true` if `X` is a palindrome integer, or `false` otherwise.

An integer is a palindrome when it reads the same backward as forward. Negative numbers are not palindromes.
input_format: A single line containing the integer `X`.

sample_tests.explanation: 121 reads 121 from left to right and right to left.
From left to right it reads -121. From right to left it is 121-.
